name: read-several
description: Reading several messages in one call. getMessages (the add-on setting getMessagesLimit is 5) on seeded POP3 messages: plain, HTML, with attachments and encrypted (content withheld), with bodyFormat, a body cut by maxBodyChars and continued with getMessage bodyOffset, rawSource as text and as base64, saveAttachments with the saved files attached again to a draft; the errors of single items (empty id, empty folder, unknown message, unknown folder) are reported next to the messages that were read, and a call above the limit, an empty list and an item without folderPath are refused. getMessages with headersOnly: the headers of three messages, the same item errors, and a call of 200 references to a message with very long headers that runs out of its result budget (the rest is reported as not read, incomplete is true); 201 items are refused. Not covered: messages that are not stored locally (IMAP), the JSON-string form of the messages argument (the extension turns it into an array first). Nothing is sent.

steps.note: Seeded mbox files have no .msf summary; running the (empty) filter list over the folder makes Thunderbird parse it.
The limit set below is 5 messages per call; a body is cut at 20 characters.
getMessages cut the body of rs-1 at 20 characters: getMessage with bodyOffset reads the rest.
Each entry is several thousand characters (headers are cut at 2000): the 400000-character budget runs out and the remaining messages are reported as not read.
